products.name: macOS Management Runbooks & IT-Support Enablement (Intune) — Commercial
products.short_description: A runbook library and enablement kit for Intune-managed Macs — enrollment, SSO, passwordless/FileVault, app/VPP, BYOD, compliance, and incident response — so support is consistent and features get adopted deliberately. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Give your team a repeatable way to run and support Macs

macOS support gets inconsistent when there are no standard runbooks and the knowledge lives in one engineer's head. This solution provides a runbook library and enablement kit for managing and supporting Intune-managed Macs — enrollment, SSO setup, passwordless/FileVault procedures, incident response, and staff training — so IT support resolves Mac issues consistently and new features get adopted deliberately.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the macOS support operating model, how the runbooks are structured, and how to keep them current as Intune/Apple features change.
  • Requirements Guide — what the team needs (Intune roles, Graph read access, remote tools, asset context) with how to verify each.
  • Runbook Library — step-by-step runbooks: ADE/enrollment, SSO setup, passwordless/FileVault procedures, app/VPP, BYOD, compliance/CA, and incident response (recover from encryption/SecureToken issues, account lock-outs) — each with triage, checks, and escalation gate.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Mac fleet health/context discovery, per-device state validation, a support-metrics/health report, safe common-fix remediation, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates per runbook, plus Best Practices for documentation, training, and feature evaluation.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A Mac-support team that resolves issues the same repeatable way and adopts new features deliberately — a runbook library and scripts you keep and reuse across the fleet.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • MACRUN-Discovery.ps1 — read-only Mac fleet health and context discovery for Intune-managed macOS
    • MACRUN-Remediation.ps1 — safe common Mac fixes for Intune-managed macOS (defaults to WhatIf)
    • MACRUN-Report.ps1 — read-only support-metrics and Mac-fleet-health summary for Intune-managed macOS
    • MACRUN-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build/adjust pilot and support target groups for Macs (defaults to WhatIf)
    • MACRUN-Validation.ps1 — read-only per-device state validation for an Intune-managed Mac

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
